BrochureContent.Content:
Property Partners McDonnell are delighted to present to the market this Exceptional 5 Bedroom Detached Family residence set on approximately 0.9 acres at Lakenstown, Ballynacargy, Co. Westmeath. Extending to an impressive c. 3,400 sq. ft. (310m2), this superb A-rated home has been thoughtfully designed to offer luxurious family living with spacious accommodation, quality finishes, and excellent energy efficiency throughout.
From the moment you enter the bright and welcoming vaulted entrance hall, the attention to detail and sense of space is immediately apparent. The property boasts an abundance of natural light with large windows, feature corner glazing, and Velux skylights throughout. The spacious sitting room with limestone fireplace provides an ideal family retreat, while the stunning Bespoke Walnut kitchen with granite worktops and large feature island unit forms the heart of the home. The kitchen and dining area opens seamlessly onto the patio and landscaped gardens, creating the perfect setting for entertaining and modern family living.
Additional ground floor accommodation includes a Walk-In Pantry, Utility Room, Home Office, Guest WC, Snug/Playroom/Sun Room, and an impressive large games room with multiple patio access points offering endless possibilities for family recreation or entertaining.
Upstairs, the mezzanine landing overlooks the entrance hall and leads to five generously proportioned bedrooms, including a magnificent master suite with vaulted ceiling, large built-in wardrobes, ensuite bathroom, and private balcony access. A luxurious family bathroom with jacuzzi bath and walk-in waterfall shower completes the first-floor accommodation.
This outstanding home further benefits from underfloor heating on both levels, a heat recovery ventilation system, high-speed fibre broadband, solar panels, alu-clad double-glazed windows and doors, private well water supply, and septic tank treatment unit.
Ideally located in a peaceful countryside setting while remaining within easy reach of Ballynacargy, Mullingar, and major transport routes, this is a rare opportunity to acquire a substantial turnkey family home finished to an exceptional standard.
Heating is by means of Oil-Fired Central Heating (under floor)

Lakenstown is a peaceful and picturesque rural location situated just outside the village of Ballynacargy in Co. Westmeath. Nestled in the heart of the Midlands, the area offers the perfect balance of countryside living while remaining within easy reach of local amenities. Ballynacargy village provides everyday services including shops, schools, sporting facilities and community amenities, while the larger town of Mullingar is approximately 20 minutes away and offers an extensive range of retail, educational and leisure facilities.
The area is renowned for its scenic surroundings, rich heritage and outdoor pursuits, with the nearby Royal Canal Greenway providing excellent walking and cycling opportunities. Lakenstown also benefits from convenient access to the N4, making it an attractive location for commuters travelling to Dublin and other regional centres. Combining tranquil rural charm with excellent connectivity, Lakenstown is an ideal setting for those seeking a quality lifestyle in the heart of County Westmeath.
